cohort: The study describes three independent cases: a 5-year-old boy with FXS and DMD, a 7-year-old girl with FXS and a de novo PPP2R5D variant, and a 33-year-old male with FXS and a maternally inherited 2p25.3 deletion.
finding: The study reports three rare co-occurrences of Fragile X syndrome with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, a PPP2R5D-related neurodevelopmental disorder, and a 2p25.3 deletion, highlighting instances where clinical features can be modified by the co-existing genetic conditions.
